name: 金庸群侠传
group_note: Jinyong-themed mudlib (金庸群侠传), sibling codebase of jyqxc (86/87 numbering; not a file-identical duplicate -- most files differ, but shares the same architecture/bug surface). Same exact bug as jyqxc: feature/name.lpc's short() called capitalize(query("id")) unguarded, crashing on any object reaching short() without an "id" property -- hit by every one of this lib's ~18 bulletin-board clones because their data/board/*.o saves use the same legacy compact binary encoding (magic bytes '#inh'/'?inh') that restore_object() can't parse, zeroing the object's dbase mapping (including "id") before throwing. Fixed identically: guarded short()'s fallback on stringp(id). Seeded fluffos/Mud2026Adm as (admin) via adm/etc/wizlist. No Chinese-name/macro/command-table bugs (is_chinese() already codepoint-correct, commandd.lpc's sscanf already matches .lpc). Full registration->look->score->quit flow and admin flow verified before and after the LPC formatter pass. Formatter reverted 3 corrupted ASCII-art zone-map files (d/huashan/map.lpc, d/shaolin/obj/map.lpc, d/shaolin/npc/obj/map.lpc), byte-identical corruption pattern to jyqxc's.
